text: Vitruvius explains a steelyard by moving a small counterweight farther along the beam until it balances a larger load. His Roman example makes distance from the pivot as important as the weight itself (Book X.3).
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Vitruvius, De architectura, Augustan Roman world, translated by Morris Hicky Morgan (1914), public-domain primary text; https://www.gutenberg.org/files/20239/20239-h/20239-h.htm . Verified primary context: Book X.3.4; chapter also specified in the stimulus.
